fusions.name: Land the Big One
fusions.desc: A raking maul that deals 32 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: River Gaff
fusions.desc: A long reach that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Crushing Embrace
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 4 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste of the Catch
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
